-- Entity: silver_sales.Account
-- Grain: One row per account per source system.
-- Merged: no. History: type_1.

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW temp_account_sap_erp AS (
    -- One row per SAP customer master, per source system.
    SELECT
        k.KUNNR AS CustomerNumber, -- STRING
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS SourceAccountID, -- STRING
        k.NAME1 AS AccountName, -- STRING
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS AccountType, -- STRING
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS Industry, -- STRING
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS BillingCountry, -- STRING
        k.LAND1 AS CustomerCountryCode, -- STRING
        k.ORT01 AS CustomerCity, -- STRING
        k.PSTLZ AS CustomerPostalCode, -- STRING
        k.ERDAT AS CustomerCreatedDate, -- DATE
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS AccountCreatedDate, -- TIMESTAMP
        CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS UserID, -- BIGINT
        k.KUNNR AS SourceSAPCustomerNumber, -- STRING
        sys.SystemID AS SourceSystemID
    FROM sap.KNA1 AS k
    LEFT JOIN meta.system AS sys ON sys.SystemCode = 'SAP_ERP'
);

SELECT CustomerNumber, SourceAccountID, AccountName, AccountType, Industry, BillingCountry, CustomerCountryCode, CustomerCity, CustomerPostalCode, CustomerCreatedDate, AccountCreatedDate, UserID, SourceSAPCustomerNumber, SourceSystemID
FROM temp_account_sap_erp;
